verdict.rationale: Titan Security Key is documented purely as a FIDO/U2F authenticator for account sign-in and 2-Step Verification (google-titan-docs-1, google-titan-docs-14), with no evidence of any API, SDK, or integration pattern for gating agent-initiated or automated actions behind a physical touch. The probe evidence confirms Titan ships no developer-facing API/SDK/MCP surface beyond the login flow, so there is no path to wire it into an agent-approval workflow.
